title: 第6章燃骨第7章引气第8章混沌
slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
【剧情回顾】
问心路十重试炼，林天行以纯粹凡人之躯，硬闯所有幻境拷问。
终局石壁前，他以指为刃、以血为墨，刻下本心答卷：不求长生，不问道果；只求这世间，无人再如我一般跪地苟活。
石壁崩碎，问心路通关。世人皆不知，六古神万古封印的核心锁钥，从不在修为、血脉、天赋之列。
它唯独认一种东西。
凡人历尽极致苦难，依旧宁折不屈的傲骨意志。
破关刹那，地心万古封印应声瓦解。沉寂亿万年的盘古精血挣脱禁锢，顺着岩层缝隙，一路向上奔涌。
柳长老率先捕捉到那股超脱时代的古老气息，当即传令石林全员撤离。无人察觉，一缕细碎金芒穿透万丈地层，悄然浸透林天行足下土地。
亿万年空寂等候，天地终究等来了这唯一的宿命钥匙。
---
柳长老的警哨刺破夜色，整片石林瞬间大乱。
三道剑光自玄天剑宗主峰破空掠下，稳稳落于石林外围千年古松之巅。三道人影伫立剑上，凛冽气场直接凝滞了周遭夜风。
为首老者须发如雪，身着深紫长老袍，腰间墨黑古剑沉寂无声，却暗藏慑人剑势。身后分立一男一女两位核心长老：男者清瘦儒雅，拂尘在手、气度温润；女者面容冷冽，背负双剑、锋芒内敛。
“柳师兄，出了何等变故？”负剑女长老沉声发问，目光扫过仓皇撤离的新弟子，眉头紧蹙。
柳长老立在石林入口，指尖掐动探测法诀，掌心悬浮一枚三百年修行的感应玉珠。此刻玉珠剧烈震颤，裂纹纵横蔓延，随时都会崩碎殆尽。
“三息之前，苍云山地底爆发超强灵压波动。”他摊开手掌，玉珠轰然化为漫天齑粉，簌簌飘落，“波动强度，彻底超出至宝承载极限。”
“震源深度，至少地下三千丈。”
紫袍老者双脚落地的瞬间，脸色骤然沉凝。数百年宗门积淀的感知，让他立刻识破异常。
“不对，这不是普通地动。”
他凝神探向地底，那股穿透万丈山体的绵延气息，诡异得令人心颤。

像是某个沉睡万古的存在，醒了。
三位长老同时垂眸，望向脚下坚硬致密的花岗岩大地。
寻常术法难伤分毫的岩层，此刻却让所有人心底泛起细微酥麻。一股低频震颤浸透肌理，无声无息，却无处不在。
咚。
声响不入双耳，直透血肉骨骼，似地壳深处擂动起一面横贯天地的巨鼓。
咚。
第二声震颤愈发清晰。石林石笋簌簌落屑，林间飞鸟尽数惊起，千百羽翼拍打夜空，盘旋嘶吼，满是惶恐。
咚。
第三声落地，整片大地彻底异动。
无横向摇晃，只有规整沉稳的垂直脉动。苍茫大地，竟似生出一颗鲜活巨心，缓缓搏动。
柳长老面色剧变，厉声传令：“鸣警钟！开一级戒备！新弟子即刻撤出石林，全速赶赴山下接引处！方圆五百丈，禁留一人！”
话音未落，一道清瘦身影自石林深处缓步走出。
粗布麻衣，身形单薄，正是林天行。他右手手背，淡金纹路隐隐发光，在夜色中格外醒目。
他步履平稳，每一步落地，都与大地脉动隐隐契合。人随地动，地随人行，因果难辨，诡异非常。
“林天行！”孟小虎挤开人群，声音颤抖，满是后怕，“你没事吧？这地动到底是什么来头？太吓人了！”
林天行未曾应答。
他的状态太过反常，无半分慌乱，亦无麻木呆滞。更像是神魂坠入一片无人知晓的秘境，半醒半惚、虚实交织。
瞳孔深处，一缕淡金微光缓缓轮转，频率与手背金纹完全同步，相生相应。
“柳师兄，此子来历。”紫袍老者目光死死锁住少年，语气凝重至极。
“天青城凡人，陆辰风引荐入宗。”柳长老以传音入密低语，“测灵无常规灵根显色，测灵石却生异象，我破格准入问心路。他身上藏着一桩天大隐秘。”

“是盘古纹。”紫袍老者直接断言，眼底翻涌着百年难遇的震惊。
“典藏阁三层残篇有载：色如流金，生于血脉，非灵非煞，开天余痕。我素来以为是上古传说，今日竟得亲见！”
四字落定，全场死寂。
content_en:
【Plot review】
In the ten-fold trial of questioning one's mind, Lin Tianxing used his pure mortal body to break through all the illusion tortures.
In front of the stone wall at the end, he used his fingers as blades and blood as ink to carve out his answer sheet: I don't ask for immortality, I don't ask for fruit; I just ask that no one in this world can survive on his knees like me.
The stone wall collapsed, asking the mind to pass the level. Everyone in the world does not know that the core key to the eternal seal of the Six Ancient Gods has never been among the cultivation, bloodline, and talent.
It only recognizes one thing.
Mortals have gone through extreme hardships, but still have an unyielding will.
The moment the barrier was broken, the eternal seal in the center of the earth collapsed. Pangu's essence and blood, which had been silent for hundreds of millions of years, broke free from its confinement and surged upward along the cracks in the rock formations.
Elder Liu was the first to capture the ancient aura that transcended the times, and immediately ordered everyone in Stone Forest to evacuate. Unnoticed by anyone, a wisp of fine golden light penetrated the ground and quietly soaked into the ground beneath Lin Tianxing's feet.
After hundreds of millions of years of waiting in silence, the world finally received the only key to destiny.
---
Elder Liu's police sentry pierced the night, causing chaos in the entire stone forest.
Three sword lights swept down from the main peak of the Xuantian Sword Sect and landed steadily on the top of the thousand-year-old pines outside the stone forest. Three figures stood on the sword, and their cold aura directly froze the surrounding night wind.
The leader, the old man, has a beard and hair as thick as snow, and is dressed in a dark purple elder's robe. The black ancient sword at his waist is silent, but it conceals a terrifying sword power. Behind him are two core elders, a man and a woman: the man is thin and elegant, with a whisk in his hand and a warm demeanor; the woman has a cold face, carries two swords on her back, and has a restrained edge.
"Senior Brother Liu, what happened?" The sword-bearing female elder asked in a deep voice, her eyes sweeping over the new disciples who were evacuating in a hurry, her brows furrowed.
Elder Liu stood at the entrance of the stone forest, pinched the detection method with his fingertips, and suspended a sensing jade bead with three hundred years of practice in his palm. At this moment, the jade bead was shaking violently, cracks were spreading vertically and horizontally, and it would collapse at any time.
"Three breaths ago, super strong spiritual pressure fluctuations erupted under the Cangyun Mountain." He opened his palms, and the jade beads suddenly turned into powder all over the sky and fell. "The intensity of the fluctuations completely exceeded the carrying limit of the treasure."
"The depth of the earthquake source is at least three thousand feet underground."
The moment the old man in purple robe landed on the ground, his expression suddenly became serious. The perception accumulated by the sect for hundreds of years allowed him to immediately see through the anomaly.
"No, this is not an ordinary earthquake."
He looked into the ground attentively, and the lingering breath that penetrated the mountain was so weird that it made people tremble.
It was like a being that had been sleeping for eternity had woken up.
The three elders lowered their eyes at the same time, looking at the hard and dense granite ground beneath their feet.
The rock formation, which was difficult to be damaged by ordinary magic, now caused a slight tingling in everyone's heart. A low-frequency tremor penetrated the texture, silent but everywhere.
Boom.
The sound could not reach the ears, but penetrated directly through the flesh and bones, like a huge drum beating deep in the earth's crust across the sky and the earth.
Boom.
The second tremor became clearer. The stalagmites in the stone forest were rustling and falling, and all the birds in the forest were startled. Thousands of wings flapped in the night sky, circling and roaring, full of fear.
Boom.
The third sound hit the ground, and the entire land completely changed.
No lateral shaking, only regular and steady vertical pulsation. The vast earth seems to have given birth to a living giant heart, beating slowly.
Elder Liu's expression changed dramatically, and he issued a stern order: "Sound the alarm! Activate level one alert! The new disciples immediately evacuate the stone forest and rush to the reception area at the foot of the mountain at full speed! No one person is allowed within a radius of 500 feet!"
Before he finished speaking, a thin figure slowly walked out from the depths of the stone forest.
Wearing coarse linen clothes and having a thin figure, he was none other than Lin Tianxing. The pale gold lines on the back of his right hand glowed faintly, making it particularly eye-catching in the night.
His steps were steady, and every step he landed was faintly in line with the pulse of the earth. People move with the earth, and the earth follows people. It is difficult to distinguish cause and effect, and it is very strange.
"Lin Tianxing!" Meng Xiaohu squeezed through the crowd, his voice trembling and full of fear, "Are you okay? What is the origin of this earthquake? It's too scary!"
Lin Tianxing did not respond.
His state is too abnormal,Not a trace of panic, nor numbness or sluggishness. It's more like the soul has fallen into a secret realm that no one knows, half awake and half in a trance, the virtual and the real are intertwined.
Deep in the pupil, a wisp of pale gold light slowly rotates, and the frequency is completely synchronized with the golden pattern on the back of the hand, corresponding to each other.
"Senior Brother Liu, the origin of this boy." The old man in purple robe locked his eyes on the young man, and his tone was extremely solemn.
"Lu Chenfeng, a mortal from Tianqing City, recommended him to join the sect." Elder Liu whispered in a secret voice, "The spiritual root showed no color as usual in the spirit test, but the spirit stone produced strange phenomena. I made an exception and asked about his mind. There is a huge secret hidden in him."
"It's the Pangu pattern." The purple-robed old man asserted directly, his eyes filled with shock that had never been seen in a century.
"There is a fragment on the third floor of the Collection Pavilion: Color is like flowing gold, born from blood, neither spiritual nor evil, leaving traces of the sky. I always thought it was an ancient legend, but today I got to see it with my own eyes!"
After the four words were settled, the whole place was dead silent.
